item_short_desc: Rothco’s Map Compass is two tools in one!  Built with kilometer and centimeter measurements, this survival compass can measure where you are on a map and guide you to your next destination when used in conjunction with the map’s scale.
description: Rothco’s Map Compass is two tools in one!  Built with kilometer and centimeter measurements, this survival compass can measure where you are on a map and guide you to your next destination when used in conjunction with the map’s scale. This outdoor compass is made of lightweight and durable acrylic plastic to help last your next outdoor venture. Measuring at 4 1/4” X 2 3/8” X 1/2”, the camping compass is a small but great addition to your outdoor gear collection. The liquid filled map compass features a large and easy to read turn dial, magnifying glass, and a lanyard.
